title: Bedrock mound inside the Great Pyramid is taller than believed

tellings.quote: But in my opinion, the bedrock mound is actually much taller than we think.

plain: The natural hill of rock that the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt was built over rises much higher inside the pyramid than people assume. That is the opinion of a researcher named Jeffrey Drum, who says on Michels' show, without citing a source, "in my opinion, the bedrock mound is actually much taller than we think." If so, more of the pyramid's core would be living rock than built stone.
